questions.question: The network of physical devices embedded with electronics, software, sensors, and network connectivity is called ______.

server_only.explanation: Internet of Things (IoT) connects physical everyday objects to the internet, enabling them to collect and exchange data.

questions.question: PaaS stands for Platform as a ______.

server_only.explanation: PaaS stands for Platform as a Service, offering development environments and tools over the cloud.

questions.question: ______ is a branch of computer science dealing with the simulation of intelligent behavior in computers.

server_only.explanation: Artificial Intelligence involves designing machines capable of performing tasks that normally require human intelligence.

questions.question: ______ generation wireless technology provides higher speeds and lower latency compared to 4G.

server_only.explanation: 5G is the fifth generation mobile broadband standard delivering multi-Gbps peak data speeds and ultra-low latency.

questions.question: In cloud computing, when services are accessible to the general public over the internet, it is called a ______ cloud.

server_only.explanation: A public cloud delivers computing infrastructure and services openly across the public internet.

questions.question: In an IoT system, a ______ converts raw sensory data into digital signals that can be transmitted across networks.

server_only.explanation: Sensors and transducers detect environmental shifts and convert them into measurable electronic signals.

questions.question: Cloud computing eliminates the need for expensive on-premise hardware infrastructure.

server_only.explanation: Cloud computing allows users and businesses to access computing resources on demand without managing physical on-premise servers.

questions.question: Smart home appliances like automated thermostats are examples of IoT devices.

server_only.explanation: Automated home appliances contain sensors and network connectivity to interact remotely, fitting the IoT definition.

questions.question: 5G technology has higher network latency than 4G technology.

server_only.explanation: 5G significantly reduces latency (delay) down to 1 millisecond compared to 4G's 20-50 milliseconds.

questions.question: A hybrid cloud environment strictly permits access only to government entities.

server_only.explanation: A hybrid cloud combines public and private cloud models; it is not restricted to government entities.

questions.question: Machine learning is a subset of Artificial Intelligence.

server_only.explanation: Machine learning is a core field and branch within Artificial Intelligence that trains algorithms on data.

questions.question: In cloud computing, multi-tenancy refers to multiple customers sharing the same physical pool of hardware resources.

server_only.explanation: Multi-tenancy allows cloud vendors to serve different customers securely from pooled computing infrastructure.

questions.question: Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive are examples of which cloud computing service model?

server_only.explanation: Cloud storage applications accessed directly by end-users via browsers or apps are Software as a Service (SaaS).

questions.question: Which of the following devices is essential in an IoT ecosystem to measure physical conditions like temperature or pressure?

server_only.explanation: Sensors capture raw environmental data (light, temperature, sound, pressure) in an IoT system.

questions.question: In which cloud deployment model is infrastructure provisioned solely for exclusive use by a single organization?

server_only.explanation: A private cloud is provisioned for exclusive use by one single entity, providing maximum control and security.

questions.question: Which AI application focuses on understanding and processing human spoken or written language?

server_only.explanation: Natural Language Processing (NLP) enables machines to comprehend, interpret, and generate human language.

questions.question: Which 5G technology capability uses multiple physical antennas to simultaneously send and receive separate data streams?

server_only.explanation: Massive MIMO clusters multiple antenna elements on base stations to expand capacity.

questions.question: Which TWO of the following are standard Cloud Service Models?

server_only.explanation: The core cloud service models are IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS (Software as a Service and Platform as a Service).

questions.question: Which TWO hardware components are primary building blocks of an IoT architecture?

server_only.explanation: IoT hardware relies on sensors (to gather environmental inputs) and actuators (to trigger physical mechanical actions).

questions.question: Which TWO deployment models are standard classifications in Cloud Computing?

server_only.explanation: Standard cloud deployment models include Public, Private, Hybrid, and Community clouds.

questions.question: Which TWO technologies form the operational backbone of autonomous self-driving automobiles?

server_only.explanation: Autonomous driving systems rely on computer vision for perception and machine learning models for navigation.

questions.question: Which THREE of the following are prominent advantages of 5G wireless technology?

server_only.explanation: 5G delivers low latency (down to 1ms), multi-gigabit speeds, and massive machine-type communication.

questions.question: Which THREE domains are practical applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI)?

server_only.explanation: AI is implemented in speech recognition (Siri, Alexa), autonomous driving (Tesla), and computer-assisted diagnostic tools.

questions.question: Match the emerging technology concepts in Column A with their appropriate definitions in Column B.

answer.column_b: Virtual machines and server storage infrastructure
Applications delivered over the web browser
Converts electrical signals into physical movement

server_only.explanation: Core associations connecting cloud service classifications, IoT components, and telecommunication standards.
